name: io.github.ni-c/mealie-mcp
title: Mealie MCP Server
description: MCP server for Mealie, the self-hosted recipe manager and meal planner

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Mealie instance, e.g. https://mealie.example.com

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token created in Mealie under Settings → API Tokens

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Exactly 'true' registers only the 17 read tools

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Accept-Language header, e.g. de-DE; localises unit and label names

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Exactly 'true' accepts a self-signed certificate, scoped to this connection

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: MEALIE_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever MEALIE_ALLOW_TOOLS left
